canDoYue: 你識開會講更新，仲識禮貌咁同意或者講出擔心。
canDoEn: Share an update, agree politely, and name an action item.

dialogue.speaker: owen
dialogue.text: Good morning everyone. Let's open the meeting and share an update today.
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨各位。我哋開會，分享一個更新。
dialogue.say: Good morning everyone. Let's open the meeting and share an update today.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The update says the deadline moved, and I am concerned about the action item.
dialogue.glossYue: 更新係期限改咗，我擔心嗰項行動項。
dialogue.say: The update says the deadline moved, and I am concerned about the action item.

dialogue.speaker: owen
dialogue.text: Could you expand on the deadline and unmute so we can hear you?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以再講個期限，同埋開返咪等我哋聽到？
dialogue.say: Could you expand on the deadline and unmute so we can hear you?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I am concerned the owner cannot meet this new deadline on Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 我擔心負責人星期五趕唔切呢個新期限。
dialogue.say: I am concerned the owner cannot meet this new deadline on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: owen
dialogue.text: Let's agree on Friday, and the owner can send the next note.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋同意星期五，負責人可以送下一張字條。
dialogue.say: Let's agree on Friday, and the owner can send the next note.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I agree on Friday, but I suggest we mute and follow the agenda.
dialogue.glossYue: 我同意星期五，但我建議靜音，跟返議程。
dialogue.say: I agree on Friday, but I suggest we mute and follow the agenda.

dialogue.speaker: owen
dialogue.text: I see that point, and we can mute the side chat.
dialogue.glossYue: 我明白呢一點，我哋可以靜音旁邊個傾計。
dialogue.say: I see that point, and we can mute the side chat.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Let's wrap up, and the owner will share one update on Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋收科，負責人星期五會講一個更新。
dialogue.say: Let's wrap up, and the owner will share one update on Friday.

understand.explain: expand on 係請人再講清楚。

chunks.pattern: Good morning everyone, let's open the meeting now and share a short ___ on the agenda today.
chunks.example: Good morning everyone. Let's open the meeting and share an update today.

chunks.pattern: I see your point, but I am ___ the owner cannot meet this new deadline on Friday.
chunks.example: I am concerned the owner cannot meet this new deadline on Friday.

chunks.pattern: Let's ___ on Friday, and the owner can share the next update before we wrap up.
chunks.example: Let's agree on Friday, and the owner can send the next note.

chunks.pattern: Let's ___ up now, and the owner will share the update after the next meeting on Friday.
chunks.example: Let's wrap up, and the owner will share one update on Friday.
